caption: Two Towers, Bologna
composition: Floodlit Asinelli and Garisenda towers at night · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The floodlit Asinelli tower rises dead center, impossibly tall against the dark sky, with the shorter leaning Garisenda tower beside it to the right. Arcaded brick palazzi frame the piazza on both sides, their ground-floor arches and a lone street lamp glowing amber. The square is empty in the 05:07 pre-dawn stillness.
